Roof Extension & Airspace Development

Rooftop extension: four new penthouses, Cricklewood NW2

Cricklewood, London NW2201725 photos

Construction of 4 new penthouse flats on the roof of a 24-flat 1930s mansion block in Cricklewood, with all residents in occupation throughout. Two new lifts were installed in the altered original shafts, staircases were extended to the new floor, and a separate Section 20 programme refurbished the communal areas, facade and electrical infrastructure under the managing agent and surveyor. JCT contract, completed 2017.
